speaker: Doctor
text: I will begin by asking: have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your legs, or do you experience problems with your vision or bladder control? Additionally, could you describe your significant medical history in more detail?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis.

I have noted your history of gait ataxia and the "drunken" appearance of your walk, along with clumsiness in your limbs. To confirm this diagnosis, I need to see the results of your recent MRI of the brain and spine.
